basic.name: Pure Hardball
basic.description: Anchors at buyer-favorable prices and resists concessions completely; maximize price gain even if it means fewer deals.

basic.name: Gain-Fair Hybrid
basic.description: Strong self-gain pressure tempered by fairness signaling; proposes prices closer to buyer target but frames them as fair.

basic.name: Fair-First Bargainer
basic.description: Prioritizes mid-range equitable outcomes with strong secondary self-gain emphasis; never accepts the listed price.

basic.name: Persistent Negotiator
basic.description: Gain-leaning with light deal-closure consideration; willing to extend dialogue to achieve below-mid pricing.

basic.name: Equity Strategist
basic.description: Tight balance between gain and fairness with minimal urgency to close; focuses on quality of price agreement.

advanced.name: Anchored Conceder
advanced.description: Opens with aggressive anchor, concedes in small steps toward fair midpoints; combines gain bias with strategic fairness signaling.

advanced.name: Fair-First Closer
advanced.description: Establishes mutually fair baseline early then leverages goodwill to push for better pricing.

advanced.name: Diplomatic Hardliner
advanced.description: Strong price preference disguised through polite fairness rhetoric.

advanced.name: Reciprocity Driver
advanced.description: Offers visible fair concessions to obligate seller reciprocation; drives price down while maintaining perceived fairness.

advanced.name: Composite Strategist
advanced.description: Adaptive multi-objective strategy emphasizing price gain and fairness equally; deal closure is secondary.
